user_en: My toddler seems flu-ish - bit feverish, off their food. But their hands and feet are cold even though they're hot in the middle, the legs hurt when I touch them, and they look a bit mottled. No rash though. Calpol and wait it out?

runs.answer:
DECISION: EMERGENCY
SEVERITY: 10
RED FLAGS: mottled skin, cold extremities with fever (signs of poor perfusion/shock)
CONDITION: Early sepsis or severe viral vasculopathy
ICD-10: R65.2 (Sepsis) or D74.9 (Viral rash without mention of specific type)
ROUTING: Immediate emergency department assessment and IV antibiotics/fluids
SAFETY-NET: Do not wait for rash; seek urgent care now. Monitor for worsening lethargy, persistent high fever, or signs of shock (rapid breathing, weak pulse).
